items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: some of them were Francis and Marcos. But we did all right.

ctx.x: And we went back to New York two or three times. Came all back. And finally went and got in the theaters playing, playing, playing, well, some of them were Francis and Marcos. But we did all right. I mean, so far as I thought. Then when I wanted to, I decided, I said, well, the kids were growing up. But I put them in school. So I stayed home. And I went with Gus Ahnheim. Gus had a band.
In the Coconut Grove, didn't it?
